answer_1.quote: LongBench is composed of 6 major task categories and 21 different tasks, covering key long-text application scenarios including multidocument QA, single-document QA, summarization, few-shot learning, code completion, and synthetic tasks.
answer_1.outputs: summaries for summarization tasks, answers for QA tasks, and code completions for code tasks

answer_2.quote: we utilize automatic metrics such as ROUGE-L and F1 to measure the similarity of the outputs to the groundtruth answers.
